# mistershell_canary_service (Resource)

Manages a MisterShell canary service. Requires MisterShell 2.1 or newer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mistershell_canary_service" "example" {
  name         = "site-ssh-decoy"
  service_type = "ssh"
  enabled      = false
  location_ids = [var.location_id]
  settings = {
    port   = 2222
    banner = "SSH-2.0-OpenSSH_9.6"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location_ids` (Dynamic) Location ids. Accepts a native Terraform value.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `service_type` (String) Service type.
- `settings` (Dynamic) Settings. Accepts a native Terraform value.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identity. Import using this ID; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.
- `origin_key` (String) Origin key.
- `origin_version` (Number) Origin version.
- `seed_key` (String) Seed key.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mistershell_canary_service.example 123
```
